papers.topic: LinearLayout — GF(2)/F2 linear maps as the universal layout algebra (Triton v3 layout system)
papers.verified: web-verified (PROMOTED from unverified-candidate — formal paper found this pass; the recon predated its publication)
papers.evidence: Header derives the model: a layout is a linear map over GF(2), fixed by its values on power-of-2 basis inputs; composition/inversion/quotient are RREF over GF(2). Abstract of 2505.23819: 'models tensor layouts using linear algebra over F_2 ... binary matrices acting on the bits of the hardware representation', integrated with Triton — matches the source exactly. Its own chapter, paired with the Four Russians box for the RREF engine.
papers.fetch_note: WebFetch arxiv.org/abs/2505.23819 成功。核实：标题《Linear Layouts: Robust Code Generation of Efficient Tensor Computation Using F_2》,作者 Keren Zhou, Mario Lezcano, Adam Goucher, ..., Phil Tillet, Thomas Raoux 等;摘要逐字确认『models tensor layouts using linear algebra over F_2』『representing tensor layouts as binary matrices acting on the bits of the hardware representation』『generic layout-to-layout conversions, eliminating the quadratic explosion』『integration with Triton』。B 档。ch20 仅用于 §7 前瞻框一句出处,GF(2) 线性律/bases/RREF 展开留给 ch23。前瞻框的技术事实另有更强的 A 档源码注释支撑:LinearLayout.h:16-90(xor 线性律 L(a⊕b)=L(a)⊕L(b) + power-of-2 bases 逐字)、LinearLayout.cpp:151(f2reduce::inplace_rref_strided RREF 调用)。

papers.topic: Four Russians / f2reduce — GF(2) Gaussian elimination (RREF) engine under LinearLayout
papers.verified: web-verified (Four Russians / M4RI, Wikipedia) + source-cited (f2reduce in Triton third_party)
papers.evidence: LinearLayout composes/inverts by row-reducing a bit-packed boolean matrix over GF(2). A 3-5 sentence box inside the LinearLayout primer ('layouts compose/invert by RREF over GF(2); f2reduce does it fast via the Four Russians block-lookup trick') demystifies the call without a separate chapter.
